title: 3D Chemistry Laboratory Bench and Acid-Base Reactions
prompt:
Use Three.js to build a simple 3D chemistry laboratory bench scene using procedural geometry. It must include 4 types of apparatus: a beaker, an Erlenmeyer flask, a Bunsen burner, and a test tube rack, arranged in reasonable positions.

[Three.js Import Method (Must Be Followed Strictly)]
Use the following importmap in <head>, and import via ES Modules in <script type="module">:
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
} }
</script>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';
// Optional: DragControls
</script>

[Reagents and Reactions]
(1) Three chemical models: acid (red), base (blue), and indicator (yellow). They can be moved into the beaker area by dragging with DragControls or raycasting and mouse input.
(2) When the acid and base are both added to and mixed in the beaker, the liquid changes to a neutral color, with purple recommended, and a bubbling/particle "boiling" effect plays. The indicator can alter the final color logic; the implementation may be simplified, but it must provide visual feedback.
(3) Heating toggle id="heatToggle": when enabled, increase the reaction rate/particle intensity, and make the numeric value shown in the DOM element with id="temperature" rise, using any reasonable unit such as °C.

[State Exposure (Required)]
Update window.__3D_STATE__ every frame:
  - chemicals: string[] (list of reagent ids currently in the beaker or already used, such as ['acid','base'])
  - mixedResult: string | null (such as 'neutral'|'acidic'|'basic'|null)
  - temperature: number
  - heatOn: boolean
  - apparatus: Array<{ name: string, x: number, y: number, z: number }> (world coordinates of the four apparatus items)
  - reactionComplete: boolean (true when acid-base neutralization is complete)

Output a single HTML file.
difficulty_analysis: L5: Dragging multiple objects, a reaction state machine, particle effects, linked heating and temperature behavior, layout of four apparatus items, and __3D_STATE__.
